mapper.select: SELECT C.ID AS COMMENT_ID, C.CONTENT AS CONTENT, C.BOARD_ID AS BOARD_ID, C.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT, C.UPDATED_AT AS UPDATED_AT, C.DELETED_AT AS DELETED_AT, M.ID AS WRITER_ID, M.PASSWORD AS WRITER_PASSWORD, M.NAME AS WRITER_NAME FROM COMMENTS C, MEMBERS M WHERE C.WRITER_ID = M.ID AND C.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND C.BOARD_ID = #{boradId} ORDER BY C.ID

SELECT C.ID AS COMMENT_ID, C.CONTENT AS CONTENT, C.BOARD_ID AS BOARD_ID, C.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT, C.UPDATED_AT AS UPDATED_AT, C.DELETED_AT AS DELETED_AT, M.ID AS WRITER_ID, M.PASSWORD AS WRITER_PASSWORD, M.NAME AS WRITER_NAME FROM COMMENTS C, MEMBERS M WHERE C.WRITER_ID = M.ID AND C.DELETED_AT IS NULL AND C.ID = #{commentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMENTS (CONTENT, BOARD_ID, WRITER_ID) VALUES (#{content}, #{boardId}, #{writer.id})
mapper.update: UPDATE COMMENTS SET DELETED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{commentId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
